methodology.forward_segmentation: Heuristically accumulate whole-model and split graph correlations to expected site counts.
methodology.period_metric: Maximum of per-rank median start-to-start decode periods.
methodology.target_sum_metric: Maximum of per-rank median AR+RMSNorm target-stage sums.
methodology.note: Retained traces have no authoritative forward ID/mode/M marker. Fused-site-only sum excludes the one remaining explicit AR+RMSNorm pair; total target sum includes it.
